description.value:
The last knuckle of one finger never grew skin — just bone showing under a thin shine.

Gift — The exposed bone reads as a knock on any door worth knocking on: +1 circumstance to Intimidation the first time you show a stranger the knuckle. Tithe — That hand fumbles under cold or fear: a −1 circumstance penalty to any check using it while you're frightened or in freezing conditions.

cinderfall.incomplete: "A −1 circumstance penalty to any check using that hand while frightened or in freezing conditions" has no clean rule-element hook: there is no selector for 'checks that physically use one specific hand' (pf2e skills don't distinguish hand use), and 'freezing conditions' has no engine-recognized trigger. The frightened half could in principle predicate on self:condition:frightened, but without the hand-specific selector the effective scope can't be stated correctly, so it's flagged rather than guessed.
